report_title: Wonderbly Complete Forensic Teardown & Deep Architecture Audit
executive_summary: Wonderbly (Lostmy.name Ltd, UK Reg 08305498, London UK) is the global category leader in personalized publishing with over 10M books sold and estimated $50M+ ARR. Built on Astro with React islands, Prismic Headless CMS, Algolia search, and a proprietary Python/Rails (Solidus) rendering engine (MU2/Chameleon). Their core strength is sentimental branding and modular algorithmic letter-assembly, but their system relies entirely on static pre-rendered asset combinations (without generative AI), lacks true child likeness, has no native Arabic/MENA localization, and incurs high international shipping costs to GCC markets.

infrastructure.behavioral_analytics: Microsoft Clarity, Contentsquare, TikTok Pixel, Meta CAPI, Google Tag Manager (GTM-NTG8CTR), Optimizely
